verdict: NEEDS_WORK
findings:

    kind: behavior-bug
    expected: R5/R6 fire when an acceptance names a manifest claim id
    observed: _enforce_claim_gates treats acceptance.subject as the claim id; dogfood acceptances use task-slug subjects
    severity: major
  - task: claim-gate-close
    kind: behavior-bug
    expected: missing aff for the claim gate refuses clearly
    observed: FileNotFoundError uncaught from subprocess.run(["aff", ...])
    severity: major
  - task: claim-gate-close
    kind: missing-test
    expected: pass done when mocked aff verdict and recheck both exit 0
    observed: only refuse cases exist
    severity: major
  - task: oracle-red-cli-surface
    kind: missing-test
    expected: oracle-backed close tests self-contained when aff missing
    observed: pre-existing oracle suite still needs real aff on PATH
    severity: major
  - task: skills-no-aff-runner
    kind: judgment
    expected: R7 plus alignment with R9 CLI-only assertion-red
    observed: skills still mention affidavit.oracle_red.is_assertion_level_red
    severity: judgment
integration:

  invariants: stamp flipped; CLI-only import direction holds
